notes.title: BombGears is Out!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707994/4dc0959c94456c2192a0db229a62323f7506ff38.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New Singleplayer mode with 20 maps
[*] Team DeathMatch
[*] Each Gear now has a different Ultimate Bomb
[*] Hats!
[*] New aim trajectory indicator
[*] bug fixes and performance improvements
[*] and more...
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access 1.2 is Out
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707994/5a5bdbe7c8df04873364233e7be6c98ee164fbb4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved map generation, now with buildings.
[*] Improved overall graphics and fixed flickering.

[*] A lot of bugfixes.
[/list]
